description: This file is a C header file defining the interface for a plugin in the COSA (Cisco Open Service Architecture) framework. It declares exported functions for initializing, checking support for objects, and unloading the plugin, along with relevant macros and licensing information.

methods.name: COSA_Init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the maximum supported version and plugin info.

methods.name: COSA_IsObjSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given object name is supported by the plugin.

methods.name: COSA_Unload
methods.description: Unloads or cleans up the plugin resources.
